metadata.title: World Digest — November 14, 2026
metadata.summary: President Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin will hold an unprecedented trilateral summit, while Mary Peltola's Alaska Senate lead grew and Nvidia's Jensen Huang lost his job.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Peltola Widens Lead in Alaska Senate Race

Mary Peltola's lead grew in Alaska's ranked-choice Senate count, now rated "likely Democratic," as vote tallying continues statewide. NBC News

Bomb Found Near Illinois Ethanol Plant

A bomb at the BioUrja plant in Peoria, Illinois forced evacuations; officials later rendered the device safe and lifted the evacuation order. NPR

Democrats Rally in Denver Post-Midterms

Jubilant Democrats gathered in Denver to strategize after midterm wins, focusing on delivering on their agenda and looking toward 2028. The Guardian

Pope Leo Urges End to Violence in Peru

During a visit to his former diocese, Pope Leo XIV called for an end to Peru's violence before enormous crowds, while measles worries mounted in the region. Al Jazeera AP News

Trump, Xi, Putin Plan Trilateral Summit

The White House and Kremlin announced plans for an unprecedented Trump-Xi-Putin meeting on nuclear non-proliferation, drawing comparisons to "Yalta 2.0." AP News

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Diplomacy & Security

Trump, Xi, and Putin plan an unprecedented trilateral meeting on APEC sidelines focused on nuclear non-proliferation AP News. Trump is not expected to raise the alleged Chinese spy involving Nvidia with Xi Politico. Separately, the White House activated its national security apparatus over FAA ground stop issues Fortune.

Domestic Politics

Democrats face a pivotal leadership fight as Chris Van Hollen challenges Chuck Schumer Axios. Congress’s top doctor, Brian Monahan, resigned amid a Pentagon probe The Washington Post. Pete Hegseth survived an impeachment bid, though critics warn the reprieve may be temporary The Guardian.

International Affairs

Over 100,000 protested across France for a fifth consecutive Saturday France 24 Euronews.com. Hungarian authorities uncovered nearly €20 million in cash during a graft probe of an Orbán-era minister BBC POLITICO.eu. Pope Leo XIV urged an end to violence in Peru amid large crowds Al Jazeera AP News.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Global Markets

  • Nvidia fallout deepens: Tech leaders rallied behind ousted CEO Jensen Huang The New York Times, while political pressure mounted on Commerce Secretary Lutnick The Hill. Musk warned Nvidia will lose "critical" deals Reuters. Berkshire Hathaway hit a record high, up 19% in Q4 CNBC.
  • Anthropic IPO looms as Wall Street questions AI valuations Yahoo Finance; Meta was fined $887M by Italy Reuters.
  • Cyber threats: Hackers stole $6.3B from Binance CNBC; an AI-fueled ransomware boom is emerging WIRED.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
GTA VI Launch Upends Work, Retail, and Physical Media

Rockstar's GTA VI approaches with $1B+ preorders CNBC, and 12.5 million US gamers plan to take time off, prompting Logitech to give 7,000+ employees the day off New York Post. Physical editions are missing codes, and Rockstar is refusing help Notebookcheck, while some "physical" copies are vulnerable to theft via flashlight Notebookcheck.

Apple Shuts Down 28-Year-Old Support Community

Apple is shuttering its Support Community forum on November 20, ending a 28-year run Yahoo Finance. The move affects a long-standing resource for users seeking troubleshooting help.

Brain Implants Restore Voice for A.L.S. Patients

Clinical trial participants with paralysis used implanted brain-computer interfaces to restore expressive communication, including speaking and singing The New York Times.

Early Black Friday Tech Deals

Apple's early Black Friday deals cover MacBooks, iPhones, and iPads MacRumors. Garmin sales are live, with discounts on Fenix, Edge, and Forerunner series DC Rainmaker. A $69 Home Assistant device can make older tech smart The Verge.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content:
Entertainment

Johnny Depp’s Ebenezer dominated the box office with a $6.7M opening day, marking a strong studio comeback The Hollywood Reporter. Amid James Gunn’s departure, Marvel’s VisionQuest finale became the most-watched in three years Deadline Deadline. Shane Gillis addressed the backlash from his SNL monologue E! News. A crew member died on the Netflix Dept. Q set Entertainment Weekly. Tiffani Thiessen revealed her hip dysplasia diagnosis USA Today.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Basketball

  • Pacers 106, Knicks 104 – Siakam and Nesmith pace Indiana in NBA Cup group play ESPN; Josh Hart, scoreless and benched in the fourth, says he's "not in a good headspace" ESPN.
  • Spurs 123, Warriors 85 – Castle's season-high 32 fuels San Antonio's 11th straight win ESPN.
  • Grizzlies 142, Pelicans 111 – Memphis ties a record with 10 double-figure scorers ESPN.
  • Rockets 125, Jazz 118 – Sengun erupts for 43 points ESPN.

Hockey

  • Hurricanes 5, Kraken 1 – Svechnikov and Jankowski each score twice as Carolina sweeps the NHL Global Series in Helsinki ESPN ESPN; captain Jordan Staal returns from injury ESPN.
  • Predators 3, Golden Knights 2 (SO) – Josi's shootout winner extends Nashville's streak to seven ESPN.

Football

  • UCLA 22, Illinois 14 – Dieffenbach returns from injury scare as No. 4 UCLA stays unbeaten ESPN.
  • Colorado 42, Houston 32 – Buffaloes earn first AP top-15 win since 2007 with Sanders on the hot seat ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Recent pricings include Modern Mining Technology on NYSE American at $4.25 and vVARDIS Holding AG on NYSE at $18, both on 2026-11-13 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Upcoming listings include Bluerock Acquisition Corp. II (Nasdaq, 11-16), Southport Acquisition Corp. II (NYSE, 11-16), Torex Resources (NYSE, 11-17), and Anthropic (Nasdaq, 11-19) Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

The S&P 500 slipped 0.40% to 7,561.67, while the Nasdaq fell 0.91% to 25,136.27 Yahoo Finance. The Dow edged up 0.10%, and the Russell 2000 lost 0.31% Yahoo Finance. The VIX rose 3.21% to 19.30 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Consumer Staples led, up 1.42%, followed by Communication Services (+1.05%) and Energy (+0.98%) Yahoo Finance. Technology lagged sharply, falling 2.01% Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Meta jumped 2.90% to $641.69, while JPMorgan gained 0.98% Yahoo Finance. Broadcom tumbled 4.76% and Nvidia dropped 2.01%, weighing on tech Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Liftoff Mobile surged 30.6% and Modine Manufacturing rose 27.9% Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Heartflow fell 19.1%, and AMD dropped 8.8% Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Nvidia was the most active Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

The 10-year yield hit 5.15% (+1.00%) Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin slid 4.34% to $68,249.27 Yahoo Finance. Crude oil dipped 0.20%, while gold was flat Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 48 Hours: Watch for continued vote-counting in Alaska's Senate race and whether the White House confirms the trilateral summit agenda. FAA ground-stop investigations may yield new details.

Next Week: Democrats' leadership vote could reshape Senate strategy. Anthropic's IPO (Nov 19) will test AI valuations amid market jitters. GTA VI launch may disrupt retail and workforce patterns.

Next Month: Trump-Xi-Putin nuclear talks could dominate geopolitics. Nvidia's leadership vacuum may trigger further volatility. Binance investigation and ransomware surge warrant monitoring.

theme.name: Summit Shadows
theme.note: Three leaders meet, markets watch, and a boardroom falls — a page of quiet alarm in cold steel blues under a single amber threat line.
